notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-Q15 'Weaving traffic' special warning sign (2023). Size A 1100 x 1600 generated (B 2200 x 3200 also tabled; note 2: A up to 80 km/h, B above), r 100. Two-part panel read from the sheet's vectors and the c / d dims: upper part yellow with c 20 yellow edge + black border to d 40 (edge + border), lower part red with a 20 red edge + 20 white border, the parts meeting on a straight line 1140 from the top (chain e 100 / k 950 arrows / h 90 = 1140; then g 60 / f 120E WEAVING / g 60 / f 120E TRAFFIC / e 100 = 1600). Drawn as a yellow panel with the standard edge + border and the red part laid over it as three polygons (red 0-1100 x 1140-1600 with the sign's R100 bottom corners and square top corners, white inset 20 R80, red inset 40 R60). Arrows: the sheet's own vector paths (tools/symbols/qld_w5-q15_weaving.svg, vec2sym2, not traced; the three white centre-line dashes 15 x 50 are white fills on the black shaft), drawn on the sheet exactly at the tabled box m 200 / n 700 / m 200 across, e 100 down, k 950 tall (x 200, y 100, 700 x 950). Legend WEAVING / TRAFFIC 120E (Series E, cap 120) white, cap tops 1200 and 1380, centred. Black and white on retroreflective yellow (top) and white on retroreflective red (bottom).
